nom: Perricone MD High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Eye Serum

segments.dry: One reviewer describes her skin as drier and aging but also sensitive, and reports the retinol serum did not irritate her while reducing fine lines after about a month; another reviewer who already uses retinol regularly found this serum caused her skin to dry out and peel when used twice daily, so she switched to nightly use only.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers who describe sensitive or reactive under-eye skin report no burning or irritation, including one prone to redness from harsh products; one reviewer who states she has no history of sensitivity or allergies nonetheless developed redness, irritation and swelling by the fourth day of use and discontinued it.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s report firmer skin and fewer visible fine lines or wrinkles after a few weeks of consistent use, though one 55-year-old reviewer with few wrinkles to begin with did not notice any change.

concerns.aging: The majority of reviewers report visibly softened fine lines, firmer under-eye skin and reduced puffiness or dark circles within one to several weeks of consistent use, some describing dramatic reductions in deep-set lines; several reviewers dissent, reporting no measurable difference even after 27 to 30 days of nightly use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the serum as lightweight and non-drying, leaving skin moisturized; one experienced retinol user reports it dried out and peeled her skin when used twice daily, and switched to nightly-only use to manage it.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or reactive under-eye skin, report no burning or irritation beyond a brief tingling that fades within a minute or after the first week of use; one reviewer with no history of sensitivity developed redness, irritation and swelling by the fourth day and discontinued use.

aspects.libelle: Brief tingling or stinging on application
High price for the bottle size

extraits.texte: I do not have sensitive skin. I've had chemical peels, laser, etc on my face and no ill effects. I also have no allergies. I bought this eye serum based on the reviews. After using it for 2 days I felt like it was stinging/burning, but chalked it up to 'oh it's working'. By the fourth day I couldn't take it. Under my eyes were red, irritated, not hydrated and starting to swell.

extraits.titre: Finally a gentle retinol eye serum
extraits.texte: I received Perricone MD Triple Retinol Renewal Eye Serum in exchange for my honest review. As someone with drier, aging skin that's also sensitive, I was worried the retinol would be too strong. It didn't irritate me at all. The serum is lightweight and doesn't feel heavy like many eye creams do. After using it for a month, I noticed a difference in reducing the fine lines under my eyes. The formula helped my skin without any redness or sensitivity. If you're looking for a lightweight, non-irritating retinol serum for the eyes, I would 100% recommend this.

A little goes a long way with this product and it almost pumps out too much so you have to try to press very gently. The directions said to use it in the morning & evening but it was causing my skin to dry and peel (I use retinol regularly) so I swapped to only nightly and sometimes skipped a night or two. I never have puffy eyes so I can't say if it helps with that but I'd hope over time it would help with fine lines and firmness due to the retinol.
The bags and lines were so bad for so long. Tried so many other types and this is the only one I found that works miracles. Super sensitive skin and aging skin, love this!

Packaged carefully, doesn't cause skin irritation for me, and one pump goes a long way. I use one pump and pat under both eyes, morning and evening. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a sticky feeling. I have used for about 3 weeks consistently and see a tightness around my eyes with less fine wrinkles.

extraits.titre: It was good didn't burn or sting
extraits.texte: I have this a few weeks to try. I take good care of my skin and I'm 55 and I don't have many wrinkles. Here is what I noticed: It absorbed really well. I didn't notice any fragrance and it did not burn my eyes or my skin. I didn't notice any changes to the eye area. I have 4 stars only for the things I mentioned and it did not negatively impact my eyes.

extraits.titre: Negligible effects for me, maybe better for others
extraits.texte: I used this exactly ad instructions said. After 27 days I barely saw a difference. I took photos every 5-6 days and couldn't identify any noticeable differences. My skin is fickle though so this might work better for others who typically have good results with retinol products.
